name: set_field_oob
description: SET_FIELD upserts a field by its canonical PropIdx (FNV-1a of the field name); it never raises IndexOutOfBounds for a key beyond the allocated count (FLUX-072 #4). GET_FIELD reads the same key back. Records are keyed by PropIdx, not position, matching the wire layout (Appendix C) and the static seed path.
